---
title: "01_sample_list"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
```


Produce a tibble of your samples with the following columns of metadata:

- ind_id: ID specific to the individual associated with your sample
- tube_id: ID specific to the sample (we always use tubes so we call it tube_id)
- project_id: ID specific to the project associated with each sample
- ploidy: ploidy of the individual associated with your sample
- sample_descr: short description of sample, typically used for grouping (e.g., NORA_candidates)
- sample_type: tissue or swab
- extr_method: extraction method; chelex or magbind 
- plate_num: leave NA for now as this will be assigned later 
- note: leave NA for now as this will be filled out by lab team

Save the tibble as a .rds file in the data/derived folder.

Using some example data in data/raw for demonstration.

```{r}
data <- read_rds(here::here("data","raw","example_sample_data.rds"))
```

For example:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
write_rds(data, here::here("data","derived","run_001_sample_list.rds"))
```
